caption: The drawing depicts a ceramic pitcher with a rounded body, a large handle on one side, and a wide pouring spout on the opposite side. The surface of the pitcher is decorated with evenly spaced horizontal stripes in alternating shades of brown, blue-gray, and off-white. Toward the upper portion of the pitcher, there is a distinct green horizontal band with a textured or mottled appearance, bordered by thin brown lines. The inside of the pitcher is shown as a muted brown-gray, and the vessel appears to rest on a flat, cream-colored base. The background is a plain, light beige with some scattered brownish marks, indicating stains or aged paper. The drawing uses soft shading to suggest the roundness and gloss of the ceramic material.
title: Water Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
